transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because... well, I keep hearing people talking about me. It usually happens when I'm at the office, like through the conference room walls, or even from my phone when it's completely turned off. It's usually the board members or my staff, and they're always saying things like I'm ruining the company. It sounds so real and so clear that I actually answer them back... and then I realize no one else in the room heard it.
About how long have you been experiencing these voices?
Um, I'd say it's been about three months. Yeah, for the past three months or so is when the voices from the walls and my phone have been happening.
How has your overall mood been over these past three months?

My mood? Um... I'd say it's been pretty normal. I haven't really noticed any big changes in how I feel day to day. I mean, obviously, I'm a bit stressed out and on edge because of what I keep hearing at the office, but... aside from that, my actual mood has been fine. I haven't been depressed or anything like that.
Aside from the voices you hear, do you feel like people are actively plotting against you or trying to harm you?

No, not really. I mean, I hear them saying those awful things about me ruining the company, but... I don't feel like they're actually setting up some sort of trap or trying to physically hurt me or anything. It's just the talking.

Um, no. I haven't ever felt like that. My thoughts are definitely my own. It's really just the voices I hear from the outside, like from the walls or my phone. Nobody is putting thoughts inside my head.
Do you ever feel that things on the TV, radio, or the internet have a special or hidden message directed specifically at you?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I watch the news and check my emails and stuff, but it's just normal information. There aren't any secret messages or anything aimed at me on the TV or the internet. Like I said, it's just the voices I hear at work.
{"intent": "Assess for delusions of being watched or spied on to evaluate for paranoid symptoms", "question": "Have you felt like people are watching you, spying on you, or monitoring what

No, I don't feel like that. I mean, obviously people pay attention to what I do at the office because of my position, but... no, nobody is spying on me or tracking me. I haven't noticed anything like hidden cameras or people following me around. Like I said, it's really just those voices I keep hearing.
Do you ever feel like your body, actions, or feelings are being controlled or manipulated by an outside force?

No, I don't feel like anything is controlling me. I mean, I'm the one making my decisions, doing my job... nobody is pulling my strings or making me do things. It's just... it's just the voices. That's the only thing that's bothering me. Everything else is normal.
Do the voices you hear ever make threats against you?

No, they don't threaten me. They just... they talk to each other. Mostly they just comment on what I'm doing, or they say things about my work. But they've never said they were going to hurt me or anything like that. It's not scary in that way, it's just really distracting.
